items.label: Space-Saving 66.5" Freestanding Design
items.value: Measuring 66.5" H x 18" W, this leaning wooden ladder takes minimal floor space. Perfect for blankets, towels, or quilts in living rooms, bedrooms, or bathrooms.

items.label: Rustic Farmhouse Style, Modern Appeal
items.value: Features a sleek, rustic solid wood design that blends with farmhouse, modern, or minimalist decor. Doubles as functional storage and stylish wall decor.

items.label: Easy Assembly – Pre-Assembled Frame
items.value: Comes with clear instructions. Install in under 10 minutes—no experience needed. Includes 25 long screws, 14 short screws, 6 iron sheets, and screwdriver.

items.label: Solid Wood & Reinforced for Durability
items.value: Made of high-quality wear-resistant solid wood with reinforced iron sheets. Non-scratch pads protect floors and walls. Supports blankets and clothes—not for climbing.

items.label: Customizable Height & 6-Layer Rungs
items.value: Includes 6 adjustable rungs—choose spacing to fit your space and needs. Great for hanging scarves, belts, plants, or displaying collections. Ideal gift for weddings or housewarmings.
